نسلنطح (form IIIq)
# نَسْلَنْطِحُ (naslanṭiḥu) /nas.lan.tˤi.ħu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِسْلَنْطَحَ (islanṭaḥa)
# نَسْلَنْطِحَ (naslanṭiḥa) /nas.lan.tˤi.ħa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِسْلَنْطَحَ (islanṭaḥa)
# نَسْلَنْطِحْ (naslanṭiḥ) /nas.lan.tˤiħ/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِسْلَنْطَحَ (islanṭaḥa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
